description:
The Amara continues to be one of our most popular single wides, and it's easy to see why. In this full walkthrough, I take you from the exterior all the way through the interior, highlighting the features that make this home stand out from the competition. 

✅ Fully tape and textured throughout
✅ Modern, residential style finishes
✅ Open concept living area
✅ Beautiful Kitchen with plenty of storage
✅ Spacious bedrooms and bathrooms
✅ Built with comfort, style, and value in mind

If you've been looking for a home that offers the feel of a traditional site built home without the site built price tag, the Amara deserves a spot on your list. 

Watch the full tour and see why so many families love this floor plan!
☎️ (325) 676-9700
📍 3301 Hickory St., Abilene, TX 79601
